title: McpView
description: The view tool (wave PX, view-tool packet): a free text picture of what the player's viewport shows, from where the body looks.

ViewInput.description: Free. The text viewport: what fills the field of view the body faces, ray by ray, as a short summary and a small grid. No arguments, or optional cols and rows (the grid size, clamped by the Body to a small range).

ViewResult.description: The viewport as text: a summary, the bands, the enclosed or open read, and the grid with its legend. Only what line of sight reveals.
